Jaeger-LeCoultre · ref. Q1368460

Master Ultra Thin Moon

Dress · 36–39mm · 50m · automatic

The Master Ultra Thin Moon is a family of elegant dress watches defined by its slim case profile and a signature moon phase and date complication at 6 o'clock. It embodies a blend of classic watchmaking aesthetics with modern proportions and technical sophistication.

The story

Introduced around 2011–2012, the Master Ultra Thin Moon joined the broader Master Ultra Thin collection that began in 1993. The initial models featured a 39mm case and were powered by the Calibre 925, an automatic movement with a moon phase, date, and a power reserve of approximately 43 hours. Over the years, the family has expanded to include various metals like stainless steel and rose gold, as well as different dial colors. A significant evolution occurred with the introduction of updated versions of the Calibre 925, which increased the power reserve to a more practical 70 hours and were incorporated into new and existing references from around 2018 onwards. The collection also introduced smaller case sizes, such as a 36mm version, to cater to a wider range of preferences.
